planets.name: pi Men c
planets.description: pi Men c crosses its star every 6.27 days and is 2.0 times as wide as Earth, found in 2018.

text.card: pi Men c was found in 2018 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 39091. Its orbit and size follow Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
